contracts.boundary: Update the main-bound release declaration to cover the merged provider sign-in warning and terminal-capture parser changes.
contracts.assertions: Provider sign-in and terminal-wrap changes retain their own boundary, invariant and fault witnesses. Unchanged release contracts remain preserved; the added UI test is included in exact main-diff coverage.

boundaryTest.name: reports a stored sign-in that cannot be resolved and warns without blocking the write

invariant.name: keeps a padded frame anchored across redraws

fault.name: fault control: dropping the sign-in warning turns the named assertion RED

contracts.boundary: The real acceptance caller must use a negative-control base that matches neither the routine nor release declaration.
contracts.assertions: Named selector witnesses check exact-base selection; the actual merged, single-commit and main-base callers were also run directly to check event propagation, unmatched-base rejection and restored success.

boundaryTest.name: selects exactly one fixed declaration by event base and covers a changed non-selected manifest

invariant.name: main release and later ordinary pushes select declarations by their own event.before

fault.exception: The actual main-base caller failed before the correction and passed afterward. Declaring the caller or its outer caller fixtures as manifest witnesses would nest the caller proof recursively or multiply its runtime.
